age.Description: Age of the participant at time of scan.

LI_lang.Description: Laterality index for language, derived from fMRI activation. Positive values indicate left-hemisphere dominance, negative values indicate right-hemisphere dominance.

Handedness.Description: Dominant hand of the participant as determined through EHI scores.

EHI.Description: Handedness score derived from the Edinburgh Handedness Inventory (Oldfield, 1971). Ranges from -100 (strongly left-handed) to +100 (strongly right-handed).

FaceStudy.Description: Include in group analyses of the face study task

FaceTest.Description: Include in group analyses of the face test task

WordStudy.Description: Include in group analyses of the word study task

WordTest.Description: Include in group analyses of the word test task

IRQ_Verbalization.Description: Score on the Verbalization subscale of the Internal Representations Questionnaire (IRQ).

IRQ_Orthogonal.Description: Score on the Orthogonal subscale of the Internal Representations Questionnaire (IRQ).

IRQ_Manipulation.Description: Score on the Manipulation subscale of the Internal Representations Questionnaire (IRQ).

IRQ_Visualization.Description: Score on the Visualization subscale of the Internal Representations Questionnaire (IRQ).
